nom: PEACH & LILY Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub

segments.sensitive: An unusually large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several managing rosacea or eczema, say this is the first scrub that has not irritated or burned their skin; two reviewers who do not specify their skin type instead report a breakout of red bumps or an allergic-type reaction of itching, swelling, and redness the day after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s who describe their skin as mature report it reduces pore size and leaves skin smoother without irritation, with two of them describing their skin as both mature and sensitive or dry.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin, including one who also uses it on dry patches on her legs, report it clears flakiness and leaves skin soft without drying it out further.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin uses it daily, especially on her T-zone, and finds it very gentle.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin says it did nothing noticeable for her, while another describing her skin as normal to dry reports a nice glow after weekly use.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin consistently report the scrub leaves skin softer and hydrated rather than dried out, including several who specifically sought a physical exfoliant that would not strip dry winter skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several managing rosacea, report no redness or irritation, even the morning after use during an active flare; two reviewers instead report new redness, red blotches, or swelling the day after their first use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report fewer breakouts or that stubborn milia cleared up and stayed away with regular use; one reviewer instead reports an outbreak of small red bumps across her face and neck the day after her first use.

aspects.libelle: Minimal grit for a physical scrub
Jar packaging means dipping fingers in

extraits.texte: I saw so many good reviews online and yall lied! I tried this once before returning. The texture is odd to say the least. It feels like gel to the touch but then left a film on my skin after rinsing. The smell starts out lightly pleasant then quickly turns to spoiled milk. The best part was the following day when my face/neck had an epic breakout of small red bumps all over.. There are too many other good options out there to suffer with this price or result.
It smells nice and it's fluffy but it doesn't do squat. If you have cry baby sensitive skin then this might be for you but for more normal skin it doesn't do much.

This thick and creamy light exfoliator feels fantastic on the skin. It is the perfect step after double cleansing to help reduce pore size and see results. The only flaw is that you have to twist open the lid and dip already fingers in - making it hard to not drip and leave water inside jar. Nonetheless, it's a fantastic daily exfoliator for my 55 yr old face!!

I never write reviews, but I had to for this! I have very, very sensitive cheeks and any sort of scrub or exfoliator (including "sensitive skin" ones) usually leaves my face feeling raw/burnt. When this product was released, I was so excited to try it since the scrubbing effect was from the rice dough texture and it just seemed to be much gentler. I was right to be excited! This scrub was incredibly gentle when I massaged this into my face. Out of abundance of caution, I used it with water, but I am confident I can use it dry too and still not have any issues. My face feels very soft after using it and I had zero adverse reaction. The scrub actually scrubs without tearing the skin and doesn't leave me having to slather my face in the repair cream to soothe. A little bit goes a long way, the container is luxurious and sturdy like Peach & Lily products tend to be, and the texture of the scrub is just lovely. Definitely recommending this one to anyone, especially those who has very sensitive skin like me!
Completely cleared up my dry flaky skin and leaves my skin so soft and smooth. I love the scent and a little goes a long way. Gorgeous packaging as well!

This is not a nuclear option for exfoliation but I would say it delivers what it claims to do. I have pustular rosacea, eczema prone skin. I needed something to help with some build up but couldn't apply a chemical exfoliant after treatments and I had some angry pustules so I was expecting some irriation. Was pleasantly surpised my skin was calm the morning after. Will continue to try this on an as needed basis!
When I first started using this scrub, it got rid of the stubborn millia on my cheek in 10ish days (of 1x day use). It's been a staple since (and the millia haven't been back).
